ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigmentation covers the inner 2/3 of both lobes. High-intensity white fields with diffuse mottling are localized at the lateral tips. The right lobe (image right) displays three distinct, high-contrast black focal spots within the white tip region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations (serrations) are visible along the entire upper boundary of both lobes, characterized by multiple sharp peaks and U-shaped valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A pronounced concave curve is observed along the upper edge of both lobes as they sweep outward towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular textured clusters of light-brown and white pixels located at the extreme tips of both lobes, indicating significant barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) are detected against the dark pigmentation of the right lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonies at both distal tips; linear white scarring on the dark surface of the inner right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip contains a larger, more bulbous cluster of barnacle growth compared to the left lobe tip.
